title: Oversize Review Rate on Remeasures
content:
# Oversize Review Rate on Remeasures

Window Replacement Contracts. The remeasure fee for a customer-requested remeasure is further multiplied by an oversize review share set by the openings the completed final measure recorded above the series standard united-inch bracket: at least 3 such openings (the many-oversize count) takes 1.25 (the many-oversize share), at least one but fewer than 3 takes 1.1 (the some-oversize share), and none takes a share of one.

The count is the oversize opening count recorded on the contract's completed final measure visit. The share multiplies the remeasure fee before the fee is rounded to the cent.

## Rate table

| Openings above the standard bracket at the completed final measure | Oversize review share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 |
| 1 or 2 | 1.1 |
| 3 or more | 1.25 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of $100 before this share)

- Final measure recorded 2 oversize openings: $110.00 (100 times 1.1).
- Final measure recorded 3 oversize openings: $125.00 (100 times 1.25).
- Final measure recorded none: $100.00.
